description: Runway ends. PROVISIONAL DRAFT 24-10-2026: headings from a public source (SkyVector), not yet checked against the AIP, in the reference the weather reports use (magnetic). Brisbane has two parallel runways: 01L/19R (3,300 m, the western one) and 01R/19L (3,560 m, the eastern one). The old crossing runway 14/32 is not listed by the source and is not used.
